title: A search for pre- and proto-brown dwarfs in the dark cloud Barnard 30 with ALMA
question: What is the nature of the 30 APEX/LABOCA sub-mm cores in Barnard 30, and are some of them proto- or pre-brown dwarfs, formed by which mechanism?

what.value: LABOCA source catalog, fluxes, sizes, and ancillary multiwavelength photometry/limiting magnitudes

evidence.quote: The data are fully described in BGH16.

what.value: Dust opacity tables used for kappa

evidence.quote: interpolating from the tables of (cite: Ossenkopf1994) for the case of thin ice mantles and a density of 10$^6$ cm$^{-3}$.
show temperature values between 17 and 21 K in the B30 region

recipe.goal: Image continuum and CO(3-2) and detect sources
recipe.method: CLEAN imaging with Briggs robust 2, primary-beam corrected; detections in 5 of 30 pointings, all unresolved
Optically thin dust emission mass M = S D^2/(B(Td) kappa)
key_parameters: Td = 15 K; kappa = 0.01715 cm2/g at 340.8 GHz; D = 400 pc
assumptions: conservative Td of 15 K; gas-to-dust 100; thin ice mantles at 1e6 cm-3; uncertainty factor of four

recipe.goal: Find IR counterparts and classify via SEDs
recipe.method: 1" search radius counterpart match; SED classification with IRAC colors, Lbol and Tbol; BT-SETTL for LB14 star mass

recipe.goal: Test gravitational stability and collapse of the three pre-BD core candidates
recipe.method: Compare LABOCA densities with Bonnor-Ebert critical density; compare ALMA masses with expectation from r^-2 profile inside the ALMA beam
key_parameters: T = 15 K; ALMA beam radius 140 AU; core formation efficiency ~30%
